title: Homelab overview
description: lxc01 host, containers, HTTP traffic through Caddy, error logs and monitoring stack health.

panels.title: Root disk
panels.description: lxc01 root disk: OS, Docker images, app configs, rclone cache, metrics and logs.

panels.title: Load (1m) per core
panels.description: 1-minute load average divided by CPU cores. Above 100% means work is queuing.

panels.title: 5xx ratio (5m)
panels.description: Share of all requests through Caddy answered with a 5xx in the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Needs the Prometheus alerting setup; otherwise stays at 0.

panels.title: CPU usage by mode
panels.description: iowait = waiting on disk, steal = CPU taken by the Proxmox host.

panels.title: OOM kills
panels.description: Processes killed by the kernel for lack of memory. Any bar here deserves a look at container memory.

panels.title: Memory per container
panels.description: Working set = memory the kernel can't reclaim; what OOM decisions are based on.

panels.title: Memory vs limit
panels.description: Only containers with a memory limit. Near 100% means the container is about to be OOM-killed.

targets.expr: sum by (name) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{name=~"$container", name!=""}) / sum by (name) (container_spec_memory_limit_bytes{name=~"$container", name!=""} > 0)

panels.title: CPU throttling per container
panels.description: Share of time a container hit its CPU limit. Only containers with a CPU limit appear.

targets.expr: sum by (name) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{name=~"$container", name!=""}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (name) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{name=~"$container", name!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: 4xx by site and code
panels.description: Share of client errors over the selected time range: 404 scanners, 401/403 auth failures, 429 rate limits.

panels.title: 5xx by site and code
panels.description: Share of server errors over the selected time range. 502/504 usually mean the container is down or too slow.

panels.title: Upstreams (Caddy view)
panels.description: Backends behind Caddy. DOWN means Caddy cannot reach the service (container stopped, wrong port, stale mount).
